Title: Design Client Portal Dashboard
Description: As a Client User I want a dashboard showing order counts, invoice status, pending candidate responses, and quick actions.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Dashboard loads counts for orders by status (Awaiting Candidate, In Progress, Clear, Adverse). 2. Shows last 5 invoices with statuses. 3. Quick actions: New Order, Invite Candidate. 4. Charts render in <2 seconds.

Title: Client Registration Step 1 – Company Details
Description: As a Client I want to submit my company details for onboarding.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Form captures company name, industry, business type, website. 2. Validation on required fields. 3. Data saved as draft until completion.

Title: Client Registration Step 2 – Compliance Details
Description: As a Client I must provide compliance-related details for legal review.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Permissible purpose stored. 2. Agreement checkbox required. 3. Data persists across refresh. 4. Submitted status logged.

Title: Client Registration Step 3 – Billing Information
Description: As a Client I must enter billing details so payments can be processed.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Stripe Setup Intent created. 2. Default payment method stored. 3. Supports card retry. 4. Autopay toggle enabled.

Title: Client Login & RBAC
Description: As a Client User I log in securely and only see data scoped to my organization.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. JWT auth. 2. Roles: Client Admin vs Client User. 3. Forbidden access if user attempts cross-client access.

Title: Create New BGV Order (Direct Mode)
Description: As a Client User I want to create a BGV order by entering a candidate’s basic information.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Form collects name, email, phone, position. 2. Allows selecting preset package. 3. Order saved in draft state.

Title: Create BGV Order with Invitation
Description: As a Client I want to invite the candidate to fill their details.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Invitation token generated. 2. Email sent via template. 3. Candidate cannot proceed without token. 4. Order status = Awaiting Candidate.

Title: Candidate Invitation Expiry
Description: As a System I must expire invitations not accepted within the configured window.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Expiry timestamp verified. 2. Job auto-updates expired invitations. 3. UI shows invitation expired message.

Title: Package Selection – Step 1 (Preset Packages)
Description: As a Client I want to choose from preset BGV packages.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Package listing displayed with pricing. 2. User can compare packages. 3. Package_id stored.

Title: Package Selection – Step 2 (Build Your Own Package)
Description: As a Client I want to select individual checks.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Components shown by category. 2. Multi-select allowed. 3. Price auto-adjusts. 4. Selected components mapped to order.

Title: Document Requirements Mapping
Description: As an Admin I want to define required documents per package.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Map LOA, ID proof, education, employment docs. 2. Min/max count configurable. 3. UI validation uses mapping.

Title: Client Branch Management
Description: As a Client I want to add and manage multiple branches.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. CRUD operations on branches. 2. Orders linked to branches. 3. Client Admin only.

Title: Client Users Management
Description: As a Client Admin I want to add, edit, and disable users.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Invite flow for new client users. 2. Role assignment. 3. Audit trail created.

Title: Admin Dashboard Overview
Description: As an Admin I want a dashboard to manage all clients, orders, invoices.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Shows global metrics. 2. Client list with statuses. 3. Orders by regions chart.

Title: Admin – View Client Summary
Description: As an Admin I want to see overall client activity.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Shows signup date, billing mode, total orders, last login, tax-exempt flag. 2. Quick actions available.

Title: Admin – Login As Client
Description: As an Admin I want to impersonate a client to troubleshoot.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Temporary token issued. 2. Audit entry logged. 3. Cannot access admin-only screens while impersonated.

Title: Admin – Pricing Override per Client
Description: As an Admin I want to override package/component pricing.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Custom price stored. 2. Applied during billing. 3. UI shows overridden price clearly.

Title: Admin – Manage Client Invoices
Description: As an Admin I want to manage invoices for all clients.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Invoice list with filters. 2. Mark as paid manually. 3. View line items. 4. Auto-payment logs shown.

Title: Admin – Manage Transactions
Description: As an Admin I want to view all financial transactions.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Shows Stripe charges, refunds, adjustments. 2. Linked to invoices. 3. Filters by period.

Title: Admin – Resend Candidate Invitation
Description: As an Admin I want to resend invitations from Admin portal.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Retrieves latest invitation token. 2. Sends email. 3. Updates event log.

Title: Candidate Portal – Start Flow
Description: As a Candidate I must authenticate using invitation link.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Token validation. 2. If expired show message. 3. Create candidate account behind scenes.

Title: Candidate – Partial Tasks Auto Save
Description: As a Candidate my progress should auto-save.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Every field change saved to profile_data. 2. Task remains draft. 3. Refresh retains state.

Title: Candidate – Personal Info Task
Description: As a Candidate I must enter my personal details.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Validations for name, DOB, phone. 2. Draft save. 3. Complete saves validated JSON.

Title: Candidate – Address History Task
Description: As a Candidate I must enter address history.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Multiple addresses allowed. 2. Validation for date ranges. 3. Completes only if all mandatory entries saved.

Title: Candidate – Employment Task
Description: As a Candidate I must enter employment history.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Multiple employers allowed. 2. End date validation. 3. Auto-save per section.

Title: Candidate – Education Task
Description: As a Candidate I must enter education details.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Can add multiple records. 2. Document mapping ready. 3. On completion task locks if admin configured.

Title: Candidate – Document Upload Task
Description: As a Candidate I upload required documents.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Upload LOA + IDs. 2. Min/max docs enforced. 3. Per-document approval by admin. 4. Candidate can re-upload if allowed.

Title: Candidate – Authorization Task
Description: As a Candidate I must digitally sign authorization.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Consent checkbox. 2. Signature recorded. 3. Task marked completed.

Title: Admin – Lock/Unlock Candidate Tasks
Description: As an Admin I want to control what the candidate can edit.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Editable_by_candidate toggled. 2. History logged. 3. Locked tasks cannot be edited.

Title: Order – Move to Vendor Queue After Payment
Description: As a System the BGV should start only after payment.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Payment success event flips order to queued_for_vendor. 2. Vendor case created automatically.

Title: Stripe – Create Checkout Session
Description: As a System create a Stripe checkout session for an order.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Correct amount. 2. Customer attached. 3. Redirect URL stored.

Title: Stripe – Handle Payment Webhooks
Description: As a System update invoice + order based on Stripe webhook.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. payment_intent.succeeded creates invoice_payment. 2. Invoice becomes paid. 3. Order transitions to queued_for_vendor.

Title: Generate Invoice for Orders
Description: As a System generate invoice upon order creation.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Invoice stored. 2. Line items generated. 3. Pricing snapshot locked.

Title: Monthly Invoicing (Postpaid Mode)
Description: As a System generate monthly grouped invoices.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. All orders grouped by client. 2. Stripe invoice generated if autopay enabled. 3. Status synced via webhook.

Title: Vendor Sync – Create IDA Candidate & Case
Description: As a System send candidate data to IDA once order is ready.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Transform local data to IDA schema. 2. jobRoleId mapped. 3. Save ida_candidate_id + reference.

Title: Vendor Sync – Handle IDA Status Webhook
Description: As a System update components based on IDA webhook.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Parse payload. 2. Update ida_cases + bgv_order_components. 3. Adjust overall_status. 4. Log timeline event.

Title: Vendor Sync – Fetch Report from IDA
Description: As a System fetch final report.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Poll/report webhook triggers fetch. 2. Store PDF + raw JSON. 3. Mark order complete.

Title: Timeline Events for Candidate & Order
Description: As a System I log all events for audit.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. candidate_timeline_events updated for each action. 2. UI displays sorted timeline.

Title: Webhook Gateway – Generic Receiver
Description: As a System capture all external events.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. webhook_events stores all payloads. 2. Processing_status tracked. 3. Failed events re-processed.

Title: Admin – Search Orders by Status/Filter
Description: As an Admin I must filter orders easily.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Filters: status, date, region, client. 2. Pagination. 3. Export to CSV.

Title: Admin – Search Candidates
Description: As an Admin I want full-text search.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Search by name/email/phone. 2. Shows latest order per candidate.

Title: Client – View Invoice History
Description: As a Client I want to see my invoices.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Shows list with statuses. 2. View invoice details. 3. Download PDF.

Title: Client – View BGV Order Details
Description: As a Client I want to see order status.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Shows package, components, candidate progress, vendor updates.

Title: Competitor Feature – Address Verification Automation
Description: As EvalRight I want to automate address verification like AuthBridge.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Map address data to automated verification API. 2. Display result in components list.

Title: Competitor Feature – Education Verification API
Description: As EvalRight I want to match SpringVerify’s automated education check.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Integrate NSR/education verification endpoint if available. 2. Show status in components.

Title: Competitor Feature – Auto-Insufficiency Task Reopen
Description: As a System reopen tasks automatically when insufficiency raised.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. IDA insufficient status reopens candidate task. 2. Candidate notified.

Title: Security – JWT + Refresh Token Rotation
Description: As a System enforce secure login.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Expired tokens rejected. 2. Refresh token rotation implemented.

Title: Security – RBAC Enforcement
Description: As a System restrict access to resources based on role.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Admin sees all clients. Client sees only theirs. Candidate sees only their data.

Title: Logging – API Error Tracking
Description: As a System log all API errors.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Error logs stored with request/response. 2. Admin can debug issues.

Title: Background Jobs – Queue Processor
Description: As a System run asynchronous tasks.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Job queue handles vendor calls, emails, invoice generation. 2. Retry with exponential backoff.

Title: Admin Report – Client-wise BGV Volume
Description: As an Admin I want a report of BGV volume by client so I can track usage and adoption.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Report aggregates total BGV orders by client over a selected date range. 2. Filters by region (US/IN/Both). 3. Exports to CSV. 4. Only admin users can access.

Title: Admin Report – Revenue & Collections
Description: As an Admin I want a report showing revenue and collections so I can monitor cashflow.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Report sums invoice totals and payments by client over time. 2. Shows outstanding amounts. 3. Can be filtered by invoice status and period. 4. Export to CSV/Excel.

Title: Admin Report – Turnaround Time & SLA
Description: As an Admin I want a TAT report to monitor SLA compliance for BGV orders.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. TAT calculated per order from created date to completed date. 2. SLA thresholds highlighted (e.g. >5 days). 3. Report can be broken down by client, region and package.

Title: Admin Report – Component-wise Outcome
Description: As an Admin I want a report of outcomes by component (Employment, Education, Criminal, etc.).
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Report shows counts per component status (Clear, Discrepancy, Unable to Verify, Insufficient). 2. Filters by date and client. 3. Export supported.

Title: Client Report – BGV Status Summary
Description: As a Client I want a summary report of BGV status so I can see where my candidates stand.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Report shows count of orders by status (Awaiting Candidate, Awaiting Documents, In Progress, Clear, Adverse). 2. Filter by job title/branch/date. 3. Exportable.

Title: Client Report – Candidate Outcome Report
Description: As a Client I want a report listing all candidates and their outcomes.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Report lists candidate name, position, branch, package, overall result (Clear/Adverse/On Hold). 2. Filterable by timeframe and branch. 3. Download as CSV/PDF.

Title: Client Report – Spend & Invoice Summary
Description: As a Client I want to see my spend over time.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Monthly invoice totals charted. 2. Breakdown by package/region. 3. Export to CSV. 4. Links to underlying invoices.

Title: Scheduled Email Reports for Clients
Description: As a Client Admin I want scheduled email reports so I don’t have to log in for weekly updates.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Client can subscribe to weekly email summary. 2. Email includes BGV count, status breakdown, and top-level spend. 3. Subscription can be turned on/off. 4. Audit logged.

Title: Admin Report – Vendor Performance (IDA)
Description: As an Admin I want a report of vendor performance so I can see SLA adherence.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Report aggregates average TAT per vendor and component. 2. Shows insufficiency rates. 3. Only admins can see. 4. Data derived from webhook/ida_cases timestamps.

Title: Configure Candidate Tasks per Package
Description: As an Admin I want to configure which candidate tasks are required per package.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Admin can mark tasks (Personal, Address, Employment, Education, Documents, Authorization) as required/optional per package. 2. Candidate portal respects configuration (only required tasks must be completed). 3. Stored configuration is versioned.

Title: Control Candidate Task Editability per Order
Description: As an Admin I want to control which sections a candidate can edit for a specific order.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. From order detail page admin can toggle editability of specific tasks. 2. Toggling immediately updates candidate_task_status.editable_by_candidate. 3. Candidate UI hides edit controls when locked. 4. Change logged in audit/timeline.

Title: Reopen Candidate Task Due to Insufficiency
Description: As an Admin I want to reopen specific candidate tasks when vendor reports insufficiency.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. On vendor insufficiency event the related candidate task is set back to editable (if configured). 2. Candidate receives notification/email. 3. Timeline event recorded. 4. Admin can override and keep locked if needed.

Title: Partial Document Requirement Tracking per Order
Description: As a System I must track fulfillment of document requirements per order.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. For each document requirement the system records status: Pending, Partially Fulfilled, Fulfilled, Waived. 2. Order cannot move to vendor queue while mandatory requirements are pending (unless waived). 3. Admin view clearly shows completion % of document requirements.

Title: Candidate – Partial Document Upload & Resume Later
Description: As a Candidate I want to upload some documents now and continue later without losing progress.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Candidate can upload any subset of required documents. 2. Each upload saves without forcing task completion. 3. UI shows which requirements are still pending. 4. On revisit, previously uploaded docs are shown with status.

Title: Admin – Approve/Reject Individual Documents
Description: As an Admin I want to approve or reject individual candidate documents.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Admin can view each document, mark as Approved or Rejected with comments. 2. Candidate sees rejection reason and can re-upload if allowed. 3. Approved documents become read-only to candidate. 4. Status contributes to requirement fulfillment.

Title: Admin – Waive Specific Document Requirement
Description: As an Admin I want to waive document requirements in special cases.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Admin can mark a document requirement as Waived with reason. 2. Waived requirement no longer blocks order from progressing. 3. Waive action is logged in audit and timeline.

Title: Prevent Vendor Initiation Until Document Requirements Met
Description: As a System I must not initiate BGV with IDA until mandatory documents are satisfied.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. When attempting to send case to IDA, system checks candidate_document_requirements. 2. If any mandatory requirement is Pending, action is blocked with clear error. 3. Admin override allowed only if requirement is Waived.

Title: Report – Document Completion Funnel
Description: As an Admin I want to see how many candidates complete their document uploads to identify friction.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Report shows counts at each stage: Invited, Started, Partial Docs, All Docs Complete, Sent to Vendor. 2. Filterable by client and time. 3. Exportable.

Title: Client – View Candidate Task Progress
Description: As a Client I want to see candidate task completion status.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. From order detail, client can see which tasks the candidate has completed (Personal, Address, Employment, Education, Documents, Authorization). 2. Display progress bar. 3. No access to fields beyond permitted compliance rules.

Title: Candidate – Final Review Before Submit
Description: As a Candidate I want a final review screen summarizing all my info and documents before final submission.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Summary screen shows all tasks and documents. 2. Candidate must confirm before final submit. 3. After final submit, configurable tasks become locked based on admin configuration. 4. Final submit time recorded.

Title: Admin – Configure Task Locking Rules Post Submission
Description: As an Admin I want to configure which tasks lock immediately after candidate final submission.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Admin can specify per package or global rules: which tasks become locked after candidate final submit. 2. System applies these rules automatically. 3. Admin can still override per order if required.

Title: Report – Error & Webhook Failure Dashboard
Description: As an Admin I want a dashboard of external integration errors to quickly troubleshoot issues.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Dashboard shows count of failed webhook_events, API errors by source (IDA, Stripe). 2. Drilling into a failure shows payload and error. 3. Admin can trigger re-process of a failed event.

Title: Report – Compliance & Audit Trail Export
Description: As a Compliance Officer I want to export audit logs and events for a specific order or candidate.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Ability to export candidate_timeline_events + audit_logs for a candidate or order. 2. Export format is CSV/PDF. 3. Access restricted to admin/compliance roles.

Title: Competitor Feature – Client Self-service Analytics Dashboard
Description: As a Client I want interactive analytics similar to leading BGV vendors.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Client analytics page shows interactive charts (TAT, clear vs adverse ratio, monthly volume). 2. Filters: branch, package, time period. 3. Uses same data as underlying reports. 4. Only Client Admin can access full analytics.
